card.name: Category and metadata labels on web pages
card.fires_on: The label word or spacing around web page metadata such as "Category", "Medical Review", or "Last Modified", often right after a dash or colon. It also fires on the space or colon beside these labels.

modes.label: Category label area
modes.description: The word Category, or the space or colon right next to it, in page headers and breadcrumbs.

modes.label: Other page metadata
modes.description: Words in review or date lines such as Medical Review or Last Modified.

card.plain: It marks the labels in web page headers, like Category or Last Modified, that come before the actual information.
